tsconfigFile_comment: TypeScript 7 has no JS API, so Stryker cannot parse tsconfig.json to rewrite its paths. The tsconfig has no extends or references, so the rewrite has nothing to change; naming a file that does not exist skips it.
disableTypeChecks_comment: The default, true, adds @ts-nocheck to every TypeScript file in the sandbox, which makes the build test see the committed generated files as changed. Only the instrumented files need it.
vitest_comment: vitest.mutation.config.ts selects the tests; its header says why test/slow, test/miniflare, and stale.test.ts are left out.
